case_number: 2024 INSC 985; CIVIL APPEAL NOS. [ARISING OUT OF SLP (CIVIL) NOS. 19602-19619 OF 2022]

parties.petitioner: Municipal Corporation of Greater Mumbai and Others

summary: Eviction proceedings under MMC Act 1888; unauthorised occupation of public premises by former municipal employees; procedural interference by High Court in framing 9 points for Inquiry Officer; Chapter V-A of Act as complete code; pre-litigation status of quasi-judicial officers; institutional bias claims rejected; High Court direction to decide specific points overruled; standard of natural justice in summary proceedings; delay due to repetitive challenges; proceedings restored to Inquiry Officer without extraneous directions.
legal_provisions_cited: Mumbai Municipal Corporation Act, 1888 Chapter V-A
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court judgment set aside; eviction proceedings to continue per Chapter V-A of MMC Act without High Court-framed points; Inquiry Officer to follow original statutory framework.
